notes.title: Removal Of Localized Languages
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’ve seen your feedback about the [u][b]non-English translations[/b][/u], and I want to thank you for being honest with us. 

[h1]I originally used machine translation to support other languages, but I now understand that it led to confusion and a poor experience for many players. That’s totally on us.[/h1]

To make things better, I’ve [i][b]removed support for these languages[/b][/i] from the game and the store page. I'm not sure if they will ever be back as I can't afford localization cost right now.

Thanks again ❤️
